summary.text: Shelby Kimball is the Democratic candidate for Ohio House of Representatives District 60 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Brian Lorenz, who has represented the district since 2023.
Ballotpedia describes her as a state advocate for the National Foundation for Ectodermal Dysplasias.
